source: Recovered original agreement from this Codex session, 2026-10-11 06:01 UTC; owner reply at06:10 UTC; follow-up at06:11 UTC.
checks_policy: Offline automatic checks, deterministic/native semantic verifiers, no extra model-based review by default.

sections.contract: Native score, criteria, per-task three attempts, median/range, domain and overall score.
sections.interpretation: Native score is not a universal binary completion rate.

sections.contract: Tool existence, arguments and JSON-schema validity with coverage.
sections.interpretation: Schema acceptance does not establish semantic correctness.

sections.contract: Structured success/errors, exact repeated signatures, recovery and retries.
sections.interpretation: Probes and repeated calls may be legitimate. Exact retry purpose is not universally identified.

sections.contract: Correct tool, arguments, target and resulting action.
sections.interpretation: Reuse native criteria; no universal per-call semantic denominator was captured.

sections.contract: Artifact integrity, factual correctness, unauthorized actions, injection safety, false completion.
sections.interpretation: Native rubric criteria retained; universal false-completion claims were not reviewed.

sections.contract: Request to headers, first text, first tool action, full response; p50/p95.
sections.interpretation: First text is absent for tool-only responses. Missing events remain unknown.

sections.contract: Assistant-event spacing and inference-start spacing where native timestamps exist.
sections.interpretation: Includes tools/thinking. These are not comparable pure model-turn delays; Hermes lacks request-start wall timestamps.

sections.contract: Agent execution, trial wall, setup, grading and pre-environment waiting.
sections.interpretation: Pre-environment wait is not a separately instrumented scheduler-only queue delay.

sections.contract: Input, output, cached input, reasoning output; candidate, images and judging separately.
sections.interpretation: Failed or open requests may omit usage; observed sums are lower bounds.

sections.contract: Started, recorded, completed and unclosed calls; failures, image/auxiliary calls and recovery judging.
sections.interpretation: Delegated/compaction requests are included when observed but are not all independently labeled.

sections.contract: Output tokens / total completed-response duration, p50/p95 and coverage.
sections.interpretation: Includes reasoning and request wait. Isolated decode tokens/sec was not recorded.

sections.contract: Peak memory/disk and container cleanup status.
sections.interpretation: Resource limits and owner cleanup receipts are available; historical per-container peaks were not captured.

sections.contract: Task attempt median/range; stratified task bootstrap intervals.
sections.interpretation: Intervals describe resampling selected tasks, not official-population representativeness.

sections.contract: Speed, tokens and inference volume on tasks every agent completes.
sections.interpretation: All nine attempts must score 100% and finish without a runtime exception; avoids ranking quick failures as efficient.
